newsitem.title: USA: Boston Properties files 29.5 mln share IPO, $25shr.
newsitem.headline: Boston Properties files 29.5 mln share IPO, $25shr.

text.p: Boston Properties Inc filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of up to 29.5 million common shares, of which 23.6 million will be offered in the U.S. and Canada, and the remaining 5.9 million shares will be offered overseas.

Shares in the Boston-based real estate investment trust, with office properties in the Boston, Washington, D.C. and Midtown Manhattan areas, are expected to be sold at $25 a share, according to the registration statement.

Underwriters for the offering are Merrill Lynch & Co, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc, Painewebber Inc, Prudential Securities Inc, and Smith Barney Inc. They have an over-allotment option of up to 3.54 million shares.

After the offering, the company's founders Mortimer Zuckerman and Edware Linde, will retain substantial control of the company, the newly formed Boston real estate investment trust said in the SEC filing. However, the company did not disclose what Zuckerman and Linde's holdings will be after the offering.
The company will own 72 properties upon completion of the offering. It will have a $300 million line of unsecured credit to finance development and acquisitions.
Proceeds from the sale of the shares will be used to reduce debt and to finance other general corporate needs, the company said.
In 1996, the company reported total revenue of $204.6 million, down from $255.19 million in 1995.
